get.description: Return booking rows filtered by the parameters you select.

parameters.name: createdFrom
parameters.description: Filter based on booking created date in epoch seconds

parameters.name: createdTo
parameters.description: Filter based on booking created date in epoch seconds

parameters.name: updatedFrom
parameters.description: Filter based on booking updated date in epoch seconds

parameters.name: updatedTo
parameters.description: Filter based on booking updated date in epoch seconds

parameters.name: startDateFrom
parameters.description: Filter based on travel start date in epoch seconds

parameters.name: startDateTo
parameters.description: Filter based on travel end date in epoch seconds

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page cursor for use in pagination

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of records returned per page

airportCode.description: Nearest airport code to this location

created.description: Time at which the object was created.

lastModified.description: Time at which the object was last modified.

cancelledAt.description: Time at which the booking was cancelled.

startDate.description: Local date when the booking starts, e.g. checkin date for hotel, date of depart for flight

gsaRate.description: Total GSA (General Services Administration) rate in USD for hotel bookings. Sum of all nights based on government per diem rates. Only populated when GSA is enabled for the company and booking type is HOTEL. Null for non-hotel bookings or when GSA is disabled.
